note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF campground in Walker Canyon, one loop on a bench between US-395 and the West Walker River; the sites sit about 4 m above the river, with a short steep bank down to it. Firewood is sold by the host. --Claude
summary: Chris Flat (Humboldt-Toiyabe NF): rec.gov 10292145 + FS page + alerts + Esri + 3DEP. Booking changed reservable -> first-come Scan & Pay (all 15 sites non-reservable); $28 confirmed, +$6 extra vehicle; season late Apr-early Oct; derived 40-ft max cleared (no source). Waterfront: riverfront fails the kayak test (pads ~4 m above the river over a ~40% bank) -> riverview lead. Website/phone flags.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade, riverfront -> riverview): the loop sits on a bench ~4 m above the West Walker. 3DEP: site 1 (38.39451,-119.45212) at 1996.1 m, bank top 1996.0 m, water 1991.8 m 18 m east - a 4.2 m drop over ~10 m (~40%); site 2 (38.39422,-119.45225) 1996.2 m, water 36 m east, last 4.5 m over ~25 m; sites 4, 6, 8 sit 50-60 m from the water at the same 4 m height. That is taller and steeper than the 2-3.7 m/30-degree bank the curation doc calls a view, so no site passes the kayak test. Channel width on Esri is ~20 m at site 1 and ~30-36 m at the pool by sites 4-6, so it is borderline river/creek, but the bank fails the creekside 'easy walk down' too. Proposed evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-26 with rec.gov site points: one loop on an open bench between US-395 and the West Walker; nearest pad (site 1) 18 m from the water but 4.2 m above it over a ~40% bank (3DEP), sites 2-9 36-60 m off at the same height -> view, not on-water. --Claude'
